about.title: About us
about.description: Luxe Watch — an authentic luxury watch retailer in Vietnam.

sections.heading: Our story
sections.body: Luxe Watch was founded by watch enthusiasts who wanted to bring authentic timepieces to Vietnamese customers with dedicated, transparent service.

sections.heading: Authenticity guaranteed
sections.body: Every watch has a clear provenance and comes with its box, warranty booklet and manufacturer papers. We refund 200% if any item is found to be inauthentic.

sections.heading: After-sales service
sections.body: Our watchmakers handle servicing, strap changes, adjustments and movement warranty for as long as you own your watch.

warranty.title: Warranty & returns
warranty.description: 5-year warranty and 7-day returns at Luxe Watch.

sections.heading: 5-year warranty
sections.body: Every watch carries a 5-year movement warranty serviced at the Luxe Watch workshop, alongside any international manufacturer warranty.

sections.heading: 7-day returns
sections.body: You may exchange or return a product within 7 days of delivery if it is unused and complete with seals, box and accessories.

sections.heading: Exclusions
sections.body: The warranty does not cover damage from impact, improper water exposure, unauthorised repairs or normal wear of straps and cases.

shipping.title: Shipping policy
shipping.description: Nationwide delivery with cash on delivery (COD).

sections.heading: Coverage
sections.body: We deliver nationwide through reputable carriers with insurance for high-value goods.

sections.heading: Delivery times
sections.body: Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi: 1–2 business days. Other provinces: 2–5 business days.

sections.heading: Shipping fee
sections.body: The standard shipping fee is shown at checkout. Shipping is free for orders above the threshold.

sections.heading: Cash on delivery
sections.body: You can inspect your watch before paying the courier. If the item does not match its description, you may refuse delivery.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Contact Luxe Watch for advice on choosing a watch.
contact.intro: We're always happy to help you find the right watch. Our team replies within 2 business hours.
